title: ATEN eco DC fwDeletes.json Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126964)
description: CVE-2026-126964 is a directory traversal vulnerability in ATEN eco DC affecting the fwDeletes.json endpoint. It allows authenticated remote attackers to delete arbitrary files due to improper validation of user-supplied paths. Exploitation occurs with SYSTEM-level privileges, potentially causing denial of service or data loss. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.5.
